sections.description: Internal Kingdom tool for managing Sermons, Events, and Calendar views (with recurrence).
sections.changelog:
• Fixed sermon single video player so locally hosted MP4/video files now display inline on the sermon page.
  • Added support for direct video file URLs including MP4, M4V, WebM, and OGV.
  • Added support for Media Library video attachment IDs in the sermon video field.
  • Added basic styling for the inline sermon video player.
